defects.title: Since you were away keeps the step list from the moment of return while its status updates, so a task can read Completed beside only some of its steps
defects.repro: Start `STANDIN_STEP_MS=1500 node server.js` with a fresh DATA_DIR and a valid token. Continue as Ana, send `long task: report check [long]`, close the page, wait 4 s, open GET / again (same browser cookie). Read the region 'Since you were away', then leave the page open 10 s and read it again, and read the Tasks article 'Task: report check'.
defects.observed: At return: 'report check Running' with 3 Done steps (accurate). 10 s later the same region reads 'report check Completed' still listing only those 3 Done steps, while the Tasks article reads 'Completed 8 of 8 steps finished' with all 8.
defects.expected: The away account should agree with itself: either keep the status as at return, or update the finished steps along with the status (Completed with all 8 steps).
